correctness.rationale: The update matrix is reconstructed explicitly from the primal-first recurrence. Each individual phase has a conjugate pair of modulus sqrt(1-r)<1. Exact symbolic multiplication proves tr(P)=2-4r+4r^2-r(q+q^{-1}) and det(P)=(1-r)^2; both other degree-two Jury inequalities are strictly positive. The remaining flip inequality is the quadratic 5r^2-(q+q^{-1}+6)r+4. A complete discriminant and admissible-boundary analysis proves every strict, marginal, and divergent regime. A rational witness confirms P(-1)=-4/15. The packaged checker passes 1941 exact comparisons; proofs of universal quantifiers do not use finite enumeration.

originality.rationale: Goldstein et al. already describe failure of varying-step PDHG despite individually safe step products, so qualitative failure is explicitly prior art. Wang–Lan–Ye give a convergence theorem with summable parameter variation and a ratio-dependent extrapolation rule, unlike the declared unit-extrapolation periodic update. Two published scalar PDHG findings inspect constant-step matrices, not products of alternating noncommuting matrices. The exact universal jump threshold, complete product-dependent phase diagram, and rational simultaneous phase-Schur-stable but periodically unstable example were not found in the inspected work. Unindexed equivalent switched-system results remain a genuine priority risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed older periodic linear-iteration, switched-systems, or adaptive PDHG analysis might state an equivalent closed threshold.

The theorem is for prescribed period-two steps and fixed unit extrapolation, not for the tuning-free feedback mechanism or the ratio-dependent extrapolation used in the 2024 sufficient convergence theorem.

value.rationale: The nontrivial unknown is a universal safe amplitude of periodic reciprocal step-ratio oscillation, which is natural when adaptive primal/dual step products are held fixed. Complete two-parameter stability classification and a sharp algebraic threshold are more informative than the known qualitative warning. It isolates a concrete design boundary for guarding against aggressive nonstationary parameter changes and distinguishes individual phase contraction spectra from the Floquet stability of the composite iteration.
